description: It is time, <name>, for you to speak with Tabetha... the hermit of Dustwallow Marsh.  She will instruct you on the creation of a powerful mage's implement.
Tabetha's shack lies deep in Dustwallow Marsh, west of Theramore.
completion: Ah, yes.  You are here for an orb or a staff, <name>?  Very well.  I will aid you in its construction.
But be forewarned--the process is a perilous one and could mean your death.
Or my death.  Definitely someone's death...
But let's hope it's someone else's death, eh?
